items.title: 'Destroyed my life': Patients of renowned surgeon speak out
items.description: Complaints had been made about this gynaecologist for years. Only when hospital management discovered that Four Corners was looking into his practice, did it start investigating further.

items.title: Can endometriosis be treated with surgery? Here's what experts say
items.description: Allegations about endometriosis surgery have alarmed experts and distressed women living with the condition. Here's what to know about the chronic disease that affects about one in seven Australian women.

items.title: Live: Coalition's approach to IS-linked families 'extraordinary', NGO says
items.description: Save the Children calls on political parties to "dial down the political rhetoric" and says no Australian child should be left "stranded". Follow live.

items.title: Albanese changes his tune on immigration as One Nation effect hits
items.description: A lot has been written about One Nation cannibalising the Coalition's vote, but less attention has been given to how the rise of the once-fringe party is also activating Labor.

items.title: More details emerge about 'mind-blowing' Mar-a-Lago shooting
items.description: Austin Tucker Martin was seen at the Mar-a-Lago resort's north gate at about 1:30am on Sunday, local time. He has been described as being from a family of "big Trump supporters".

items.title: Up to 600mm rain falls on NT station in 'once in a lifetime' event
items.description: A tropical low circling over south-eastern parts of the Northern Territory is continuing to bring damaging winds and heavy local rainfall in the Simpson and parts of the Barkly and Tanami areas.

items.title: Developer signs Trump Tower deal for Gold Coast worth $1.5b
items.description: Plans are underway for a $1.5 billion Trump Tower on Surfers Paradise, which would be one of Australia's tallest towers if approved.

items.title: Gordon Brown urges police to investigate if Andrew used RAF bases to meet Epstein
items.description: Former British prime minister Gordon Brown has urged British police to investigate if Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor used taxpayer-funded jets and Royal Air Force bases to meet with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

items.title: Andrew's daughters face uncertain future after his shock arrest
items.description: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's arrest has cast another long shadow over the York family. While his ex-wife, Sarah Ferguson, has vanished from public view, their daughters Beatrice and Eugenie face an uncertain future.

items.title: Centre-right 'betrayed' West, MAGA icon tells Australian conservatives
items.description: Benjamin Harnwell, the "international editor" of Steve Bannon's War Room podcast, says centre-right politicians have "betrayed" the West by supporting "mass immigration".

items.title: Pub left without 'parmas' as cyber attack targets chicken processor
items.description: A cyber attack at Hazeldenes chicken processing plant in central Victoria has stalled production and left butchers and pubs across the state without chicken.

items.title: Mexican army kills drug boss 'El Mencho' as country ramps up pressure on cartels
items.description: Powerful Mexican drug lord Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes, known as "El Mencho", is killed in a military raid, sparking a wave of unrest and violence in several Mexican states.

items.title: 'No longer sustainable': Nine newspapers to stop printing in Tasmania
items.description: Rising production costs and growing digital audiences are behind the company's decision to no longer print and distribute its newspapers, which includes The Age and The Financial Review, in Tasmania.

items.title: Breaking: 'Deeply embarrassed' Richmond forward banned over drink driving charge
items.description: Mykelti Lefau is banned for two matches after a drink driving charge that will see him miss a pre-season clash as well as round one.

items.title: How becoming friends with an 82-year-old made age seem irrelevant
items.description: Headlines often highlight the divisions between older and younger Australians, but research suggests intergenerational friendships can help to reduce age-based discrimination in both directions, while offering other benefits.

items.title: BAFTAs Film Awards see best actor upset, Aussies miss out
items.description: British actor Robert Aramayo has beaten frontrunners Timothée Chalamet and Leonardo DiCaprio to take the leading actor BAFTA.

items.title: Forget sides, these four salads are satisfying meals
items.description: If you’re after a healthy and summery dinner, these salads are a meal in a bowl and will tempt even the salad avoiders.

items.title: Canberra man jailed 20 years for killing ex-wife in Bruce home
items.description: A 73-year-old man who fatally stabbed his former partner in their kitchen in 2023 has been sentenced in the ACT Supreme Court.

items.title: Greenland, Denmark say 'no thanks' to Trump's hospital ship offer
items.description: Denmark and its territory Greenland reject Donald Trump's offer to send a naval hospital ship to the Arctic island coveted by the US leader.

items.title: How Milano Cortina's dispersed Games will impact Brisbane 2032
items.description: The 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympics Games was the first to follow a dispersed model. With Brisbane 2032 also set to have this set up, there are plenty of things to be aware of.

items.title: Two big tax holes are perpetuating Australia's wealth inequality
items.description: Intergenerational inequality will only be dealt with by taxing the people that have the money, not by cutting the taxes of those who don't have it.

items.title: Brisbane owner quoted $70,000 a year as home insurance premiums surge
items.description: Home insurance premiums continue to rise, with properties in natural disaster-prone areas paying the most.

items.title: Police scour bushland for kidnapped Sydney man Chris Baghsarian
items.description: Police officers are scouring dense bushland in Sydney's north-west for the missing 85-year-old grandfather, following a police operation overnight.

items.title: What led to ex-Sydney police boss's alleged assault after knock and run game
items.description: A former senior Sydney police officer accused of assaulting two men with a baseball bat who played a drunken game of knock and run at his house has told a court he "wasn't there to play" with home invaders.

items.title: Crypto and Starlink used to roll out first universal basic income plan
items.description: Citizens of the Marshall Islands will receive "free money" as the government launches a world-first universal basic income scheme.
